About us

A Bible-centered church family in Lewisville.

Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville is a local congregation of Deeper Christian Life Ministry (DCLM). We exist to help people know God deeply, live in biblical holiness, and walk in His purpose.

Who we are

Changed from the inside out

“At the heart of our calling is a simple conviction: God still changes lives.”

We are a Bible-centered Christian church and community committed to the message of holiness unto the Lord — not outward religion or “feel-good” Christianity, but a life genuinely changed from the inside out, where true faith in Jesus Christ shapes how we think, live, speak, work, act and relate to others.

Through the preaching of the Gospel, prayer and obedience to Scripture, we have seen broken lives restored, families strengthened, and individuals redirected toward lasting hope and purpose.

Our emphasis on holiness is not legalism — it is a response to God’s love. It is the call to live differently and please God daily in a world filled with confusion, compromise and pressure. We prioritize inner transformation over external rules, and we value a modest, respectful environment that allows everyone to focus completely on the presence of God.

Why we exist

Grace that transforms, truth that clarifies

We believe the Gospel is about how we live right now — and about where we go after death.

  1. To help people experience salvation and new life in Christ

  2. To teach practical, Bible-based Christian living

  3. To build strong families and communities rooted in truth and integrity

  4. To prepare believers for faithful living on earth and eternal life in heaven

Our message & heritage

Shaped by Scripture since 1973

Deeper Christian Life Ministry has been shaped by a consistent focus on Scripture and personal holiness under the leadership of Pastor W. F. Kumuyi, who founded it in 1973.

Pastor Kumuyi is a global voice for biblical holiness and a widely read author. Through the Global Crusade with Kumuyi (GCK), he continues to reach millions, empowering them to live a life of spiritual power and integrity.

His preaching is marked by clarity, depth and careful attention to Scripture — making the Bible accessible to everyone from everyday workers to professionals, and shaping a global community centered on the authority of God’s Word.

Our vision

The church we’re committed to being

  • Biblically grounded in a shifting cultural landscape
  • Spiritually alive, not merely religious in form
  • Strong in truth, love and moral clarity
  • Active in serving communities with compassion and integrity

We believe the same Gospel that changes lives anywhere in the world is fully relevant to life in the United States today — addressing anxiety, identity, brokenness, success, failure and the search for meaning.

Our goal

A life that thrives now and forever

Our goal is simple: that people would not only believe in Christ but walk with Him daily in a way that brings real transformation now and, one day, an eternal reign with Christ in heaven.

A life aligned with God brings stability in uncertainty, purpose in confusion, and hope in difficulty. This is the heart of Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville: to live holy unto the Lord, to walk in godliness, and to help others do the same — so we can thrive both in this life and in eternity with God in heaven.

Leadership

The people who shepherd us

General Superintendent

Pastor (Dr.) W. F. Kumuyi

Founded Deeper Christian Life Ministry in 1973 as a Bible study of 15 students at the University of Lagos, where he lectured in mathematics. His preaching is known for its clarity, its depth in Scripture, and its call to holy living.
